question: How many seasons of the rugrats are there?
text: The original Nickelodeon *Rugrats* has **9 seasons**. The 2021 reboot is a separate series with **3 seasons**. ([paramountglobalcontent.com](https://paramountglobalcontent.com/title/rugrats-the-original?utm_source=openai))
